market_outlook.short_term: Highly volatile. Oil above $108 and diesel at $6/gal drive inflation fears; CPI print is the pivotal catalyst. Bessent's failed yield intervention creates policy uncertainty. Expect 5-8% S&P 500 swings. Energy and gold outperform; growth and consumer discretionary lag. Bond yields likely to stay elevated, pressuring equities.
market_outlook.long_term: If Iran conflict de-escalates within 2-3 quarters, oil normalizes and inflation eases, supporting a recovery in rate-sensitive sectors. AI capex cycle (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel-ASML) and healthcare innovation (AI diagnostics, M&A) provide structural growth. Trade-war escalation with Canada adds 6-12 month drag on cross-border commerce. AI governance and regulation will shape tech valuations.
